QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Athena Pierce
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p221##k, the leader of the archers. I'm a little nervous about meeting her!\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p221#, the leader of the archers in #m10001000#. She seems strong and wise, yet very kind.

0.0: As a proper resident of #m10001000#, it wouldn't do to miss out on greeting #p221#. I think it would be best for you to meet #p221# in person and formally introduce yourself. There's absolutely no need to be nervous, so just feel free to pay her a visit.\r\n- #p229#

1.0: Welcome. You must be #h0#. Word of your deeds has already reached us here. It is only proper that I introduce myself as well. I am #p221#, and I lead the archers in this town.
1.1: How has your time here been? It seems many people in #m10001000# have already grown quite fond of you. I hope you will always find this a place where you can rest your weary body.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, I must say.
